what_this_is: Stage B cells assembled from the cache, with §5's analysis. No world is generated here. Every cell in this assembly was drawn from a consumed design-block seed, so this assembly is an exercise of the instrument and not a measurement of the claim.

analysis.aggregation_rule: supported only if the predicted relation holds with an interval excluding zero in every claimed configuration; otherwise mixed, never a best-configuration finding
analysis.predicted_sign: negative: earlier onset predicts a lower held-out log loss

limits: the readout is the frozen backoff the acquisition harness uses, with its alpha imported rather than tuned here; no Stage B world was used to fit it
the withheld pair set is the one the world declares, and the behavioural window is the world's own onset + 1 to + 100, not a fixed cycle number
a world with no withheld pair in its behavioural window is reported as not measurable and excluded -- never as a zero (AGENTS 13b)
